bootstrap_note: empirical row draws; not independent learned generator fits
source_role_policy: freeze and reuse one assignment per dataset across all analysis seeds; seeds vary generator/sample/learner randomness only
evaluation_exposure_policy: recovery02 evaluation is development-exposed; never relabel it as a new final_test; final_test remains sealed and unevaluated

selection_definition.training: freeze extension roles once; cap train at 2000 using seed 20261029
selection_definition.evaluation: freeze extension evaluation once; cap at 1000 using seed 20261029; exploratory
selection_definition.tune: not passed to generator, learner, or evaluation
selection_definition.final_test: never selected, scored, or passed to a model
selection_definition.seed_policy: analysis seeds never change outer roles or capped row IDs
